scope: Independent sealed-archive readback of failed offline IO root/target metadata observation001; no Gradle, dependency acquisition, or mutable publication-output inspection.
limitations: Only sealed archive inspected for run/output evidence, not mutable live outputs or full raw logs.
Freshness uses archived original output mtimes and actual generation task marker; copy mtimes are not evidence.
POM root resolved dependency list does not describe complete KMP resource variants or all missing transform configuration prerequisites.
Stale desktop and pre-generation root POMs are not source-bound pre-switch baselines.
No library or consumer testcases, package publication, root metadata success, ABI equivalence, dependency neutrality, or complete notices/legal clearance established.

evidence_basis.dry_run: Archived dry-run receipt, sanitized graph, and lead review agree on 272 graph entries and 10 separately --rerun IO POM/module tasks; not task execution evidence.
evidence_basis.failure: Archived actual receipt reports exit1/26.01s. Sanitized task/error records independently contain the failing core common metadata transform/configuration and exactly 45 distinct missing offline artifacts.
evidence_basis.root_pom: Archived XML parsed independently without DTD/entity processing. Its recorded original mtime lies strictly inside the actual run interval, the generation task executed, and SHA differs from the stale pre-generation observation.
evidence_basis.desktop_pom: Archived XML parsed independently, but original mtime predates this run and hash equals the pre-generation observation. Not a source-bound pre-switch baseline.
evidence_basis.absent_outputs: Collector observations report all five .module files and Android/JS/Wasm POMs absent at observation001 archive time. No mutable live output path was inspected in this review.
evidence_basis.source_binding: All four archived 693-entry before/after maps are equal and match current selected files at independent readback.
evidence_basis.logs: Only sealed sanitized logs inspected. Full raw-log hashes are retained by lead archive; this review did not compare mutable raw logs.
